verdict.rationale: Statsig documents its own background automations for specific domain tasks. Scheduled Rollouts gradually deploy a feature gate over time, Autotune automatically reallocates traffic toward the winning variant, and alerts catch regressions. There is no evidence of a general automation builder where users define their own autonomous background workflows. CLI-in-CI/CD is a user-side arrangement and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable automation/workflow engine, documented triggers and actions, details on how scheduled rollouts are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Gradually deploy a feature over time by setting up a Feature Gate as a Scheduled Rollout.
They automatically find the best variant among a group of candidates while dynamically allocating traffic to optimize for a single target metric.
